description_md:
# Student, Large Corporates and Institutions DK

København S, DK, 2300

**Job ID: 7570**

Are you interested in corporate banking and financial analysis? Join LC&I Denmark and support management and client teams working with some of the largest and most sophisticated corporate and institutional customers in the Danish market. We are looking for a student to be part of LC&I Denmark covering some of the largest and most sophisticated corporate and institutional customers in the Danish market. You will have many great opportunities to learn and grow as you advance your career with us.

**About this opportunity**

As the Student in Large Corporates & Institutions you play a valuable role in focusing in creating great customer experiences for corporate and instituional customers through our relationship strategy and in-depth expertise. 

**What you will be doing:**

* Support management with financial reporting, data management and project-related analysis.
* Assist client teams with credit analysis, financial follow-up and capital-related analysis.
* Prepare client presentations and update presentation materials.
* Work with Client Associates to maintain and improve databases.
* You will support Client Associates in optimizing administrative tasks where excellent excel skills will be preferable

The role is based in Copenhagen.

**Who you are**

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the four key values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imaging you share with us. To succeed in this role, you have strong financial analytical skills, good in excel- and data base related projects and have excellent interpersonal skills.

**Your profile and background:**

* You are studying to obtain a Master’s degree in Finance within the next 2-4 years
* You have a high degree of personal drive and you are good in finding new ways of doing things
* You have strong capabilities in Excel, PowerPoint and programming would be an advantage
* You have practical expirenced using AI tools
* You are proactive and have a commercial attitude with a positive mindset
* You are fluent in Danish and English

**What we offer**

**People** come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

**A culture** that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

**Hybrid working model** – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

**Diversity and inclusion** are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, let’s get in touch!

**Next steps**

Submit your application no later than 04/12/2026. For more information about the position, you are welcome to contact Tina Volsgaard +45 61222911, tina.volsgaard@nordea.com or Charlotte Buhl +45 2527 9823, charlotte.buhl@nordea.com.

**The recruitment process consists of the following steps:**

* Preliminary CV selection
* Interview with the hiring leader
* Background and referencecheck

**We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.**

**We build relationships.** We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

**We learn and develop.** We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

**We lead change.** We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

**We are Nordea.** We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
